text:
[LTAC.4.4] Timer facts have no TTL beyond their one-shot nature.
A timer fact that has been asserted fires its follow-up at or
after its `fire_at`, regardless of how long the engine has been
running. Engine restart and timer persistence belong in the
runtime spec.

---

idris.name: ltac_5_3__never_lost_timed
idris.note: 'Regardless of how long the engine has been running': over any history, the timer has no TTL beyond its one shot, and no length of history loses it. LESS than the clause: restart and persistence are the runtime spec's, outside.
